title: Optional bee.evidence state on pattern concepts, surfaced in knowledge report
action: Add optional pattern-concept frontmatter field bee.evidence with enum present|wired|exercised and optional companion bee.evidence_ref (free string naming the enforcing hook/guard/doctor check/test). In check.rs: a non-enum bee.evidence value on any concept becomes profile warning invalid_evidence_state naming file and value; absent stays valid (reads as present). In report.rs build_report: add an evidence-ladder section — counts per state over type:bee.pattern concepts (absent counted as present) and the list of pattern files at present-only, so grooming can flag important patterns stuck at doc-only. Unit tests: enum accepted, bad value warns, absent defaults, report counts and present-only list correct.

truths: Absent field stays valid and reads as present
Invalid value warns with file and value named, never errors the bundle
Report shows per-state counts and the present-only pattern list
Existing check and report behavior otherwise unchanged

trace.outcome: Add optional bee.evidence ladder state to pattern concepts, surfaced in knowledge report
